source.title: Enhanced Thermofluidic Modeling and Open Source Rigorous Simulation of Hydrogen Fueling Systems Validated with Real-world Data

anonymous_access_check.method: HTTP GET without credentials, followed redirects
anonymous_access_check.interpretation: The paper's public code claim is recorded, but the linked folder was not anonymously downloadable during this recheck. This is an access/rights boundary, not evidence that the authors do not possess the code or measurements.

minimum_requested_package: six de-identified complete fills with a common time base
instantaneous mass flow or cumulative transferred mass
storage cascade, compressor, precooler, valve and stop/fault states
tank geometry, initial conditions, protocol/APRR settings, calibration and uncertainty
written reuse terms for derived metrics and IJHE publication
claim_boundary: The peer-reviewed paper and preprint establish a high-value real-station data-request lead. They do not supply an independently downloadable raw archive in this recheck, so no full-loop validation score or completion claim is made.
